primaryReads.summary: Teamup documents administrator-controlled overlap prevention within a single sub-calendar. The published browser steps reject overlapping entries there.
primaryReads.limits: Embedded interactive demonstration not operated; no account/runtime test; not a claim about cross-calendar enforcement or Cloud Calendars.

primaryReads.summary: The FAQ distinguishes events representing bookable openings from events representing occupied time. It discusses resource-specific sub-calendars, scheduling access and separately managed reservation processes.
primaryReads.limits: Publisher descriptions only; broad promotional elimination-of-conflict language is not adopted as a guarantee.

existingCoverage.task: Coordinate schedules across different work accounts
existingCoverage.basis: Fresh full OneCal comparison body distinguishes combined view and copied busy availability. Other two are related existing routes, not reread this batch.
existingCoverage.decision: No new multiple-jobs page; would repeat core view-versus-copy distinction.

existingCoverage.task: Explain an ICS feed that has not updated
existingCoverage.basis: Fresh full secret-address body already covers subscriber-controlled refresh, import versus subscription and urgent organiser confirmation. Sync guide is an indexed related route, not reread here.
existingCoverage.decision: Existing guide supports task; do not transplant WordPress caching fixes or CalendarBridge cadence into iOS guidance.

existingCoverage.task: Use CalDAV on iPhone with correct permissions and availability expectations
existingCoverage.basis: Fresh full body covers device setup, read permissions, selected calendars, provider checks and no implied availability-copy feature.
existingCoverage.decision: No generic CalDAV sharing variant justified.

singleCandidateGap.task: Confirm a room or shared resource reservation rather than merely placing its name in a calendar event
singleCandidateGap.keywordStatus: Editorial intent candidates derived from observed publisher tasks; not measured queries or keyword volume.
singleCandidateGap.distinctFromExisting: Sharing guide defines people/access; meeting-link guide addresses virtual conferencing; week view describes visual conflicts. None of the six reviewed bodies explains requesting a physical resource, checking its acceptance or policy, and rechecking resource status after a change. Whole-corpus keyword check found mentions but no dedicated procedure.
singleCandidateGap.publicationStatus: Justified research candidate, not ready to author or claim as a Cloud feature. No new page drafted.
neededNextEvidence: Read current Google and Microsoft primary room/resource reservation and response documentation.
Verify whether Cloud Calendars exposes resource identity and response at all using read-only native inspection before product instructions.
If unsupported, frame a provider workflow with explicit limits or add a brief boundary to existing planning guide; do not create a thin promise page.
boundaries: Do not claim Cloud has Teamup overlap blocking, resource inventory, capacity management or booking approvals.
Do not imply a meeting location field, invitation receipt, online link or empty week grid confirms a room booking.
Do not claim visual conflict detection reserves time atomically across accounts.
